entries.source_text: Pawniard Community Day Community Day Event Time Saturday, November 21, 2026, 2:00 PM — 5:00 PM Local Time Add to calendar ▾ Share Share this event Copy

entries.name: Pawniard
entries.label: Lure Encounters — Saturday — Normal
entries.source_text: From 2:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time , Pawniard will have a very high chance of appearing at PokeStops with active regular Lure Modules.

entries.name: Pawniard
entries.label: Lure Encounters — Saturday — Shiny
entries.source_text: Pawniard attracted to regular Lure Modules will still have an increased chance to be Shiny and may have a Special Background. That's more chances to encounter the featured Pokemon even after the event hours!

entries.name: Pawniard
entries.label: Raids — Saturday — Normal
entries.source_text: Take a few snapshots during Community Day for a surprise! During the event, you can snap an AR Photo and get photobombed by Pawniard.

entries.name: Pawniard
entries.label: Field Research — Saturday — Normal
entries.source_text: November Community Day—themed Field Research will be available! Catch Pawniard to earn rewards such as Stardust, Ultra Balls, additional encounters with Pawniard, and more! You may even find Field Research that leads to encounters with Pawniard that have a Special Background—if you're lucky!

entries.name: Pawniard
entries.label: Timed Research — Saturday — Normal
entries.source_text: Check in at a Community Ambassador event to receive Timed Research with Pawniard encounters featuring a Special Background and other premium item rewards. Find a nearby meetup on the Pokemon GO event map .

entries.name: Pawniard
entries.label: Timed Research — Saturday — Shiny
entries.source_text: Trainers will have an increased chance of encountering Shiny Pawniard during Community Day. Shiny Pawniard can be evolved into Shiny Bisharp and Shiny Kingambit.
